units.source_text: The order gets murky too. Feeling can precede language, language can expose a feeling, and afterward you may not know which came first.
units.output_text: It can be a bit confusing as to what came first.

units.source_text: I don't think you need to solve that before using whatever words eventually help you understand it.
units.output_text: Sometimes you have to feel first before you can put it into words. Sometimes you have to put it into words to understand what you're feeling.
And sometimes you just never know.
